title: FolderArchitectureSchema
description: Defines the canonical folder structure, naming conventions, and file-type rules for the medusa-agent-skills repository. Used by validate-folder-architecture.mjs to enforce structural integrity.

allowed_top_level_dirs.description: Permitted top-level directories. Any other top-level directory is a violation.

allowed_top_level_files.description: Permitted top-level files (relative to repo root). Any other file is a violation.

excluded_paths.description: Glob-like patterns for paths that should never exist in the repo (e.g., .bak files, scratch outputs).

enforced_paths.description: Paths that MUST exist in the repo (key structural files).

plugin_requirements.description: Required and optional files/directories per plugin.

required_files.description: Files that every plugin must contain (path relative to plugin root).

required_dirs.description: Directories that every plugin must contain (relative to plugin root).

allowed_extensions.description: Permitted file extensions inside plugin directories.

forbidden_patterns.description: Regex patterns for forbidden files inside plugins.

required_files.description: Files that every skill directory must contain.

forbidden_at_root.description: Forbidden file patterns at the reports/ root level.
